newsitem.title: USA: CKE Restaurants files to offer 6 mln common.
newsitem.headline: CKE Restaurants files to offer 6 mln common.

text.p: CKE Restaurants Inc filed Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration to sell up to six million common shares.
The stock offered is being issued to provide part of the financing necessary for CKE's acquisition of Hardee's Food Systems, the company said in the filing.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 39,444,420 common, CKE said in the filing.
CKE has granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to 900,000 additional common shares to cover any over-allotments, the company said.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Equitable Securities Corp, and Robertson, Stephens & Co.
Upon consummation of the acquisition, CKE will own, operate, franchise and license 4,153 branded restaurant units in the United States and aboard.
